children: National Bank of Greece (NBG) on Wednesday reported net profit of €996 million ($1.12 billion) for the first nine months of 2026, up 2% from the same period last year, on strong net interest income and higher fees.
Net interest income grew 5% year on year to €1.68 billion
CEO Paul Mylonas said the bank could exceed its earnings per share target for 2026
The bank said in July that it expected earnings this year of more than €1.40 per share
Fee and commission income increased to €371 million from €336 million in the same period last year
The bank's non-performing loan ratio stood at 2.4%
Deposits increased by €3.9 billion year on year, up 7%
